_doc: Datasets the eval suite uses. kind: oracle = diff vs cached Python reference output (data/expected/<name>/); consistency = too big for the reference, so invariants + diff vs the best verified version's cached output (data/consistency/<name>/). Generator args are recorded so any dataset can be regenerated.
_reference_doc: Every new eval is compared with this version (results/<v>-vs-<ref>.md and a section in the report). Before comparing, the reference's result gets any untimed stages the current framework has added (review, windows, counters, growth, amd64-knobs) via --amend, so metrics are like for like; timed metrics come from the new eval's interleaved A/B, which re-times the Gate C baseline (the best submitted version) in the same session.
